summary_zh: 本页标题为“反间计”，配有一幅古代人物的插图，该人物身着古装，手持竹简，表情严肃，似乎在思考或谋划。

page_text_ocr_zh:
战国时期，燕国大将军乐毅率军攻打齐国。他统率燕、赵、韩、秦、魏五国的兵马，只用半年时间，就占领了齐国七十多座城池。
齐国只剩下即墨和莒这两座城，眼看就要灭亡了。乐毅继续进攻，带领大军围困了即墨。
page_text_en:
During the Warring States period, General Yue Yi of Yan led his army to attack the State of Qi. He commanded troops from five states—Yan, Zhao, Han, Qin, and Wei—and within half a year, captured over seventy cities of Qi.
Qi was left with only two cities, Jimo and Ju, and was on the brink of extinction. Yue Yi continued his offensive, leading his army to besiege Jimo.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了战国时期燕国大将军乐毅率领五国联军攻打齐国，迅速占领七十多座城池，并围困齐国最后的两座城池之一——即墨。

page_text_ocr_zh: 即墨的守城大将名叫田单，他看看城外密密麻麻的燕军，再瞅瞅城里稀稀拉拉的齐军，心里想：这场仗不能硬拼。幸好，即墨的城墙又厚又高，城里的粮食够吃三五年。田单对百姓们说：‘燕军围在城外，风吹日晒，还要从远处运粮食来；我们住在自己家里，吃喝不愁，只要守好城门，一定能等到燕军撤退！’
page_text_en: The commander defending Jimo was named Tian Dan. He looked at the dense燕 army outside the city and then at the sparse Qi troops inside, thinking to himself: 'This battle cannot be fought head-on.' Fortunately, Jimo's walls were thick and high, and the city had enough food to last three to five years. Tian Dan told the people: 'The Yan army is encamped outside, exposed to wind and sun, and must transport food from afar; we live in our own homes, with no worries about food or drink. As long as we guard the city gates well, we are sure to wait until the Yan army retreats!'
summary_zh: 即墨守将田单面对燕军围城，分析敌我形势，认为不宜硬拼，凭借坚固城墙和充足粮草，鼓励百姓坚守城池，等待燕军撤退。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这个时候，乐毅也看着高高的城墙，对士兵们说："齐国只剩下这两座城了，我们不用着急，死死围住即墨就行了。等到他们把粮食吃光了，就会打开城门，乖乖投降，不费我们一兵一卒。"
田单和乐毅，一个守城，一个围城。一转眼，三年就过去了。
page_text_en:
At this time, Yue Yi looked at the tall city walls and said to his soldiers, "Qi only has these two cities left. We don't need to rush. Just tightly besiege Jimo. Once they run out of food, they will open the gates and surrender peacefully, without costing us a single soldier." 
Tian Dan and Yue Yi, one defending the city, the other besieging it. In no time, three years had passed.
summary_zh: 乐毅对士兵们表示将长期围困即墨，等待齐军粮尽投降，而田单与乐毅对峙三年，双方僵持不下。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这一天，忽然有密探向田单报告："田将军，燕昭王死了！燕太子即位做了新国君。"
田单立刻琢磨起来："听说，这位新国君当太子的时候就跟乐毅不和。如果趁这个机会把乐毅赶走，让燕国换一个将军来，我们不就有机会突围了吗？"
page_text_en:
One day, a secret agent reported to Tian Dan: "General Tian, King Yan Zhao is dead! The Yan crown prince has ascended the throne as the new king."
Tian Dan immediately began to think: "I heard that this new king, while still crown prince, had a strained relationship with Yue Yi. If we take this opportunity to get Yue Yi removed and have Yan replace him with another general, wouldn't we then have a chance to break out?"
summary_zh: 密探向田单报告燕昭王去世、燕太子即位的消息，田单由此想到利用新旧国君与乐毅的矛盾，设法让燕国更换将领，从而创造突围的机会。

page_text_ocr_zh:
于是，田单叫来几名密探，
派他们悄悄潜入燕国，散布
谣言。"你们听说了吗，乐毅
将军要当齐王了！"
"啊，不可能吧？"
page_text_en:
Then, Tian Dan called several secret agents,
and sent them to secretly infiltrate Yan State to spread
rumors. "Have you heard? General Yue Yi
is going to become King of Qi!"
"Ah, impossible, right?"
summary_zh: 田单派密探潜入燕国散布谣言，称乐毅将军要当齐王，以挑拨燕国君臣关系。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“乐毅将军没用上半年，就夺取了齐国七十多座城，可是即墨和莒这两座城，却三年也没有攻下来，这是为什么呀？就是因为他偷偷跟齐国人讲和，想留在齐国称王。”
“对呀，如果燕国换一个将军去攻城，齐国早就灭亡了！”
page_text_en:
"General Le Yi didn't even use half a year to capture over seventy cities of Qi, yet Ji Mo and Ju, these two cities, have not fallen in three years. Why is that? It's because he secretly made peace with the people of Qi and wants to become king in Qi."
"Exactly! If Yan had replaced him with another general to attack the city, Qi would have fallen long ago!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了燕国酒馆内，民众议论乐毅久攻即墨和莒城不下，传言他暗中与齐人讲和、意图称王，若换将则齐国早亡，反映了田单散布的谣言在燕国民间传播的效果。

page_text_ocr_zh:
谣言像长了腿似的，越传越广。
燕惠王听说后气坏了，立刻更换
大将军赶去即墨，抓乐毅，代替
他攻打齐国。乐毅见情况不妙，
只好逃跑。
田单看自己的计策成功了，又开
始想办法，他要打败围城的燕军。
page_text_en:
Rumors spread like they had legs, growing wider and wider.
King Hui of Yan, upon hearing this, was furious and immediately replaced
the general, sending him to Jimo to capture Yue Yi and take his place
in attacking the State of Qi. Seeing the situation was dire, Yue Yi
had no choice but to flee.
Tian Dan saw his plan had succeeded, and began thinking of new ways
he could defeat the Yan army besieging the city.
summary_zh: 谣言在燕国广泛传播，燕惠王听后大怒，更换将领并派兵抓捕乐毅，乐毅被迫逃跑；田单见计策成功，开始谋划下一步如何击败围城的燕军。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他命令即墨城里的老百姓，每天吃饭前，必须先盛出一碗饭，摆在院子里，供奉给祖先。天上的乌鸦看到院子里的美食，成群结队地飞了过来。燕军每天都能看到一群群乌鸦，哑哑叫着从头顶飞过，像一片片黑云似的飞到城里，惊得目瞪口呆。
page_text_en: He ordered the common people of Jimo to set aside a bowl of rice before each meal, placing it in the courtyard to offer to their ancestors. The crows in the sky, seeing the food in the courtyards, flew over in large flocks. The Yan soldiers saw crowds of crows every day, cawing loudly as they flew overhead, like dark clouds sweeping into the city, leaving them stunned and speechless.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了即墨城内百姓为祖先供奉食物，引来大量乌鸦飞入城中，燕军士兵目睹此景，惊愕不已。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他们好奇地向城里的老百姓打听。老百姓得意地说："乌鸦降落，天神下凡。过不了多久，就会有神仙来教我们打胜仗了！"燕军听了，都半信半疑。没过几天，又有老百姓传："以前乐将军抓到俘虏，管吃管喝，关上几天就放回家了。要是新来的燕国大将军抓到齐国人，就会把鼻子割掉。我们早就吓怕了，谁还敢打仗呀！"
page_text_en: They curiously asked the townspeople inside the city. The townspeople proudly said, "Crows have descended, the gods have come down. In no time, a divine being will come to teach us how to win the battle!" The Yan soldiers listened, half-believing, half-doubting. A few days later, another townsman said, "Previously, General Le treated captives well—feeding and housing them, then releasing them after a few days. But if the new Yan general captures a Qi person, he will cut off their nose. We’ve been terrified for a long time—how could anyone still dare to fight!"
summary_zh: 即墨城内百姓向燕军士兵传播谣言，称乌鸦降落是天神下凡，将有神仙助齐军取胜；又说新任燕将残暴，会割掉齐人鼻子，导致燕军士兵惊恐不安，动摇军心。

page_text_ocr_zh: 还有的老百姓叹气说：‘唉，我们的祖先都埋在城外的墓地里，如果燕军挖了祖先的坟墓，那可怎么办呀！’这些话传到燕国大将军的耳朵里，他想：‘割鼻子的方法好呀，把齐国人吓住了，即墨城不就容易攻打了吗？挖了齐国人的坟墓，齐国人肯定更害怕，哪里还有心思守城！’
page_text_en: Some common people sighed, saying: 'Alas, our ancestors are buried in the cemetery outside the city. What if the Yan army digs up their graves?' These words reached the ears of the Yan general, who thought: 'The method of cutting off noses is excellent! If we scare the Qi people, won't the city of Jimo be easier to capture? If we dig up the graves of the Qi people, they will surely be even more frightened and have no heart left to defend the city!'
summary_zh: 即墨城内百姓担忧燕军挖掘祖先坟墓，此话传至燕军将领耳中，他想到挖坟可进一步恐吓齐人，使守城军民更加恐惧、失去斗志。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他果然下令，抓到齐国的俘虏，就把他们的鼻子割掉。他还派人挖开了齐国人祖先的坟墓。齐军一看，被俘虏后鼻子就保不住了，作战时都更加勇猛了；又看到祖先的坟墓被挖开，齐军都痛哭起来，请求田单说：‘田将军，请您带领我们出城，打跑燕军！’
page_text_en: He indeed gave the order: capture Qi soldiers and cut off their noses. He also sent people to dig up the tombs of the ancestors of the Qi people. When the Qi army saw that their noses would be cut off if captured, they fought even more bravely; and when they saw their ancestors' tombs being dug up, they all wept bitterly, pleading with Tian Dan: 'General Tian, please lead us out of the city and drive away the Yan army!'
summary_zh: 燕军将领下令割齐国俘虏的鼻子并挖掘齐人祖先坟墓，齐军因此更加勇猛作战，并痛哭请求田单带领出城反击燕军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
一天深夜，燕军睡得正香，忽然，大地“砰砰砰”震动起来，一大群“怪物”冲进了燕军的营帐。“怪物们”头上顶着锋利的尖刀，身上长满了五颜六色的龙纹，身后拖着熊熊燃烧的火尾巴。
燕军被它们撞上，不是被尖刀刺伤，就是被踩伤，还有的被火尾巴点着了。士兵们吓得大叫起来：“快跑呀，齐国的神兽来了！”
page_text_en:
One night, the Yan army was sleeping soundly when suddenly, the ground began to shake with a 'bang bang bang'. A large group of 'monsters' charged into the Yan army's camp. The 'monsters' had sharp blades on their heads, colorful dragon patterns on their bodies, and blazing fire tails trailing behind them.
When the Yan soldiers were hit by them, some were stabbed by the blades, some were trampled, and others were set on fire by the tails. The soldiers screamed in terror: 'Run! The divine beasts of Qi are here!'
summary_zh: 即墨城内百姓点燃火牛阵，火牛冲入燕军营地，士兵们惊恐万分，以为是齐国神兽降临，四处奔逃。

page_text_ocr_zh: 慌乱中，大将军揉揉眼睛仔细一看：‘嗨，这不是神兽，是牛啊！’可是，他还没来得及集合军队，就被牛踩死了。原来，田单搜集了一千多头牛，给它们披上绣满蛟龙的彩布，角上绑好锋利的刀子，牛尾扎上浸满油的芦苇。他又让人在城墙上凿开几十个洞口，把牛从洞口赶出去，然后点燃了芦苇。牛的尾巴被烧疼了，就狂怒地冲进了对面燕军的大营。
page_text_en: In the chaos, the general rubbed his eyes and looked closely: 'Hey, this isn't a divine beast, it's a cow!' But before he could gather his troops, he was trampled to death by the cows. Originally, Tian Dan had collected over a thousand oxen, dressed them in colorful cloths embroidered with dragons, tied sharp blades to their horns, and fastened oil-soaked reeds to their tails. He then had people dig dozens of holes in the city walls, drove the oxen out through the holes, and lit the reeds. When the oxen's tails were burned, they charged furiously into the Yan army's camp across the way.
summary_zh: 田单实施火牛阵，点燃牛尾后驱牛冲入燕军大营，燕军将领惊愕未及反应即被踩死，火牛阵大破燕军。

page_text_ocr_zh:
火牛的后面，跟着五千名齐军。
他们画着大花脸，拿着刀枪猛
杀猛冲。燕军吓得哭爹喊娘，
撒腿就跑。
田单率领士兵乘胜追击，很
快就收复了齐国失去的七十多座
城池。齐国终于安全了。
page_text_en:
Behind the fire oxen, followed five thousand Qi soldiers.
They wore painted faces, wielding swords and spears, charging fiercely. The Yan army was terrified, crying out and fleeing in panic.
Tian Dan led his soldiers in a pursuit, quickly recapturing over seventy cities lost by Qi. Qi was finally safe.
summary_zh: 火牛阵大破燕军后，田单率齐军乘胜追击，收复失地，齐国重获安全。

page_text_ocr_zh:
终于收复啦！
被燕军围困后，田单放出了三个假消息。燕惠王和大将军听信后，赶走乐毅，割了俘虏的鼻子，挖开了齐国人祖先的坟墓。他们这样做，不但没有吓住齐军，反而激发了齐军的士气。最后，田单出动火牛阵，一鼓作气，打败了燕军。像田单这样散播假消息，让敌人上当受骗的计策，就叫反间计。
page_text_en:
Finally, we've reclaimed it!
After being surrounded by the Yan army, Tian Dan spread three false messages. King Yihui of Yan and his general, believing them, dismissed Yue Yi, cut off the noses of captured soldiers, and dug up the tombs of the ancestors of the Qi people. Their actions did not frighten the Qi army, but instead boosted their morale. In the end, Tian Dan launched the fire ox formation, struck with one mighty effort, and defeated the Yan army. A strategy like Tian Dan's—spreading false information to deceive the enemy—is called a counter-intelligence tactic.
summary_zh: 本页总结了田单运用反间计和火牛阵击败燕军的全过程，最终齐军收复失地，城上士兵欢呼胜利。
